BTC.note: Binance hack: an exchange breach, not Bitcoin itself; 90% now covered
BTC.detail: Binance (an exchange) lost about US$6.3bn on 29-30 Oct; the FBI says North Korea did it. It was not a flaw in Bitcoin. Binance says it has covered 90% of losses from its own funds (all BTC fully backed), plans to reopen withdrawals Sun 1 Nov, and expects a verifiable reserves proof around 3 Nov. Watch for the attacker selling stolen BTC. Separately, Bitcoin Core disclosed a medium-severity bug (CVE-2026-117350) that can make non-Linux nodes run out of memory; no funds at risk, fixed in 29.5/30.4/31.2/32.1. Quantum: new estimates remain theoretical, hardware expected early 2030s.

TSLA.detail: No confirmed Tesla breach. A Sept 2026 hacking-forum claim is unverified.

MSTR.detail: Strategy itself was not hacked. The Binance hack only moved its share price through Bitcoin.

SEMI.detail: No breaches at SEMI's top holdings. Intel's Israel factory explosion is an operations issue, not a security one.
